$comment: Single source of truth for the JS<->WASM ABI: packed-snapshot field layouts, shared enums, and the version stamp. `npm run generate:abi` emits cpp/engine/abi.generated.hpp and wasmBridge/abi.generated.js; the wasm build fails if they are stale. Bump abiVersion on any externally observable ABI signature, layout, or enum change. initSandWasm() checks both the version and a generated schema/export fingerprint, which catches stale committed sandEngine artifacts immediately.

playerSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildPlayerSnapshot (player.inc); read by the authority worker and presentation engine.

itemSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildItemSnapshot (items.inc); also the external GL item layout consumed by glSetItems.

creatureSnapshot.$comment: float32 creature records built by CreatureSystem and consumed by the external GL renderer.

inventorySlot.$comment: Inventory and cursor stack record shared by the C++ float32 snapshot writer and JavaScript reader. snapshotParameter reads a per-record value instead of an InvSlot member.

projectileSnapshot.$comment: float32 projectile records used by the authority worker and external GL renderer.

craftingRecipe.$comment: int32 recipe headers; ingredientStart/count index craftingIngredient records.

craftingIngredient.$comment: int32 recipe ingredients: kind selects exact material or material flag.

glPlayerExt.$comment: float32 records the browser packs for engine_gl_set_players from authority-worker snapshots.

soundEvent.$comment: float32 semantic audio events drained from the authoritative engine. Coordinates are absolute world cells so streaming cannot move a queued sound.

perfSnapshot.$comment: double records written by engine_perf_snapshot. Fine step phases accumulate across both layers; counts are totals for the last step. Bump abiVersion on layout change.

missionSnapshot.$comment: int32 mission header built by MissionSystem. Objective coordinates are absolute world cells and remain stable across streaming.

objectiveSnapshot.$comment: int32 authoritative objective records built by MissionSystem.

worldContext.$comment: int32 semantic description of one absolute world coordinate. Feature bounds are inclusive and feature ids are stable for a worldgen version.

testBodyState.$comment: double diagnostic records returned by engine_test_body_state and engine_test_body_state_layer.

PlayerInput.$comment: Input bitmask shared by player.inc, the browser input layer, and the authority worker.

WeatherKind.$comment: Authoritative environmental weather event selected for the simulation and presentation.

InventoryItemKind.$comment: Inventory/world-drop stack identity. Empty stacks are represented by count=0.

ProjectileKind.$comment: Projectile actor kind used by simulation snapshots and presentation mirrors.

CraftIngredientKind.$comment: How a crafting ingredient value is interpreted.

Tool.$comment: Legacy tool ids (tools.inc); the creative palette prefers setCreativeMaterial.

CreativeKind.$comment: What an engine_set_creative_material selection refers to.

CreatureSpecies.$comment: Stable creature ids plus simulation, population, behavior, and rendering descriptors.

CreatureAttackState.$comment: Replicated enemy telegraph/fire state used by simulation, transport, and GL presentation.

PlanetId.$comment: Planet policy shared by campaign metadata and the C++ simulation.

SurfaceBiome.$comment: Surface climate classification returned by semantic world queries.

CaveBiome.$comment: Cave realm classification returned by semantic world queries.

WorldAreaTag.$comment: Composable semantic location tags used by world queries and natural spawn rules.

WorldFeatureKind.$comment: The innermost deterministic generated feature containing a coordinate.

WorldSiteRole.$comment: Nested role inside a generated feature; spawn policy can target a role without inspecting cell materials.

MissionId.$comment: The first three ordered IRIS campaign operations.

MissionPhase.$comment: Authoritative lifecycle for a deployed mission.

ObjectiveKind.$comment: Mission objective semantics interpreted by the authority and HUD.

ObjectiveState.$comment: Locked objectives are revealed when their prerequisites complete.

SoundEventType.$comment: Semantic game sounds. The engine reports what happened; the browser audio mixer owns synthesis, spatialization, and voice policy.

constants.$comment: Shared scalar constants. INV_SLOTS must equal INV_HOTBAR + the grid size (asserted in common.hpp).
